description: A body region on the overview (decision 0011). A region with `detail` has a region page; one without is shown grey as 'in preparation'.

name.description: For bilateral regions this is combined with a side word (左/右, Left/Right), so the English form is lower case.

model.description: Base name of a model in models/generated (<model>.glb and <model>.catalog.json).

side.description: Side the model file depicts; the other side is shown mirrored.

frame.description: Model groups the camera fits when the region opens.
